title: Christmas Cactus, Schlumbergera
body_html:
The Christmas Cactus is a very charming houseplant! It features flattened stems which will eventually produce beautiful flowers. It's an easy to care for and is extremely popular around the holidays! Flower color will vary. This cactus is a very popular plant, but most people are not aware of its special needs. Not all cacti are native to arid desert climates and require infrequent, sparse watering.

This Christmas Cactus, scientifically known as Schlumbergera, is an easy-to-care-for plant that blooms in the winter with vibrant flowers. With a variety of colors available, it will add a festive touch to any home. Enjoy its low maintenance and beautiful display during the holiday season.

title: Yellow Ixora (Ixora chinensis) | إكسورا صينية صفراء
body_html:
Yellow Ixora (Ixora chinensis)

Yellow Ixora is a compact evergreen flowering shrub valued for its glossy green foliage and bright clusters of small star-shaped yellow flowers. It is widely used in UAE gardens, villa landscapes, borders and outdoor pots.

Plant Details

  • Botanical name: Ixora chinensis
  • Common names: Chinese Ixora, Jungle Flame, Yellow Ixora
  • Family: Rubiaceae
  • Plant type: Evergreen flowering shrub
  • Flower colour: Yellow
  • Growth habit: Compact, bushy and densely branched
  • Best use: Garden borders, flowering hedges, villa gardens, patios, balconies and outdoor containers

UAE Care Guide

  • Light: Full sun to partial shade. In peak UAE summer, recently planted or container-grown plants can benefit from light afternoon protection while establishing.
  • Watering: Keep the soil evenly moist but never waterlogged. Check the top 2–3 cm of soil before watering. Outdoor pots may need much more frequent watering during peak UAE heat.
  • Soil: Fertile, well-draining soil. Ixora performs best when the root zone is not allowed to stay soggy.
  • Fertiliser: Feed during active growth and flowering with a suitable flowering-shrub or acid-loving plant fertiliser according to label directions.
  • Pruning: Light pruning after flowering helps maintain a dense, compact shape.
  • Care level: Easy to moderate.

Why Choose Yellow Ixora?

  • Bright yellow flower clusters add strong seasonal colour.
  • Suitable for both pots and landscape planting.
  • Works well as a compact flowering border or low hedge.
  • Well represented in UAE nursery and landscape ranges.

Natural variation: Live plants naturally vary in height, fullness, number of branches and amount of flowering. Flower quantity depends on season and plant maturity. Decorative pots are included only when specifically selected as a variant.

إكسورا صينية صفراء (Ixora chinensis)

الإكسورا الصفراء شجيرة مزهرة دائمة الخضرة تتميز بأوراق خضراء لامعة ومجموعات جميلة من الأزهار الصفراء الصغيرة على شكل نجوم. وهي مناسبة للحدائق والمداخل والأحواض والشرفات والتنسيق الخارجي في الإمارات.

تفاصيل النبات

  • الاسم العلمي: Ixora chinensis
  • الاسم الشائع: إكسورا صينية / إكسورا صفراء
  • الفصيلة: Rubiaceae
  • نوع النبات: شجيرة مزهرة دائمة الخضرة
  • لون الأزهار: أصفر
  • طريقة النمو: كثيفة ومتفرعة بشكل مدمج
  • الاستخدام: حدود الحدائق والأسيجة المزهرة والفلل والشرفات والأصص الخارجية

العناية في الإمارات

  • الإضاءة: شمس كاملة إلى ظل جزئي. النباتات الحديثة أو المزروعة في أصص قد تستفيد من حماية خفيفة من شمس الظهيرة خلال أشد فترات الصيف.
  • الري: تُحافظ التربة على رطوبة متوازنة من دون إغراق. يُفحص أول 2–3 سم من التربة قبل الري، وقد تحتاج الأصص الخارجية إلى ري أكثر تكراراً خلال حرارة الصيف.
  • التربة: تربة خصبة وجيدة التصريف.
  • التسميد: يُستخدم سماد مناسب للشجيرات المزهرة أو النباتات المحبة للتربة الحمضية خلال موسم النمو وفق تعليمات المنتج.
  • التقليم: يساعد التقليم الخفيف بعد الإزهار في الحفاظ على شكل كثيف ومرتب.
  • مستوى العناية: سهل إلى متوسط.

اختلاف طبيعي: تختلف النباتات الحية طبيعياً في الارتفاع والكثافة وعدد الفروع وكمية الأزهار، كما تختلف كثافة الإزهار حسب الموسم ونضج النبات.

title: Mini Monstera (Rhaphidophora tetrasperma) | مونستيرا ميني (رافيدوفورا تتراسبيرما)
body_html:
Mini Monstera (Rhaphidophora tetrasperma)

Rhaphidophora tetrasperma, commonly known as Mini Monstera, is a fast-growing tropical climber with glossy green foliage. As the plant matures, the leaves develop distinctive natural splits and fenestrations. Despite its common name, it is not a true Monstera.

Plant Details

  • Botanical name: Rhaphidophora tetrasperma Hook.f.
  • Common names: Mini Monstera, Monstera Minima
  • Family: Araceae
  • Origin: Peninsular Thailand and Peninsular Malaysia
  • Plant type: Evergreen tropical climbing plant
  • Growth habit: Fast-growing climber with aerial roots
  • Foliage: Glossy green leaves that develop splits as they mature
  • Support: A moss pole, trellis or plant stake encourages stronger upright growth
  • Best placement: Living rooms, offices, reception areas, shelves and bright indoor corners

Care Guide

  • Light: Bright indirect light is ideal. Medium indirect light is tolerated, but growth may be slower.
  • Watering: Water when the top 2–3 cm of soil feels dry. Avoid keeping the roots continuously wet.
  • Soil: Loose, well-draining indoor potting mix.
  • Temperature: Warm indoor conditions around 18–28°C are suitable.
  • Humidity: Moderate humidity is preferred.
  • Care level: Easy to moderate.
  • UAE care: Keep away from direct air-conditioning airflow and protect from harsh afternoon sunlight through glass.
  • Maintenance: Wipe leaves when dusty and attach new climbing growth to a moss pole or trellis when required.

Available Variations

  • Small — 30–40 cm / Nursery Pot: AED 77
  • Medium — Approx. 40 cm / 12 cm Plastic Pot: AED 105
  • Large — 65–80 cm / 15 cm Plastic Pot + Moss Pole: AED 175

Safety

Rhaphidophora tetrasperma contains calcium oxalate crystals and can cause irritation if chewed or ingested. Keep away from pets and small children.

Common Problems

  • Yellow leaves: Often caused by excess watering or insufficient light.
  • Brown edges: Can occur when the plant becomes too dry or humidity is low.
  • Small leaves with few splits: Usually improve with brighter indirect light, maturity and climbing support.
  • Pests: Check periodically for spider mites, scale and fungus gnats.

Natural variation: Live plants naturally vary in height, fullness, leaf size and number of splits. The delivered plant may differ slightly from the photographs.

مونستيرا ميني (Rhaphidophora tetrasperma)

رافيدوفورا تتراسبيرما نبات استوائي متسلق سريع النمو يُعرف تجارياً باسم مونستيرا ميني. يتميز بأوراق خضراء لامعة تظهر فيها شقوق طبيعية جميلة مع نضج النبات، ولكنه ليس من جنس المونستيرا علمياً.

تفاصيل النبات

  • الاسم العلمي: Rhaphidophora tetrasperma Hook.f.
  • الاسم الشائع: مونستيرا ميني / مونستيرا مينيما
  • الفصيلة: Araceae
  • الموطن الأصلي: شبه جزيرة تايلاند وشبه جزيرة ماليزيا
  • نوع النبات: نبات استوائي داخلي متسلق دائم الخضرة
  • طريقة النمو: متسلق سريع النمو مع جذور هوائية
  • الأوراق: أوراق خضراء لامعة تتطور فيها شقوق طبيعية مع النضج
  • الدعامة: تساعد دعامة الطحالب أو التعريشة على نمو النبات بشكل قائم وقوي
  • أفضل مكان: غرف المعيشة والمكاتب والاستقبالات والرفوف والزوايا الداخلية المضيئة

دليل العناية

  • الإضاءة: يفضّل الإضاءة الساطعة غير المباشرة، ويمكنه تحمل الإضاءة المتوسطة مع نمو أبطأ.
  • الري: يُروى عند جفاف أول 2–3 سم من التربة مع تجنب بقاء الجذور مغمورة بالماء.
  • التربة: خليط تربة داخلي خفيف وجيد التصريف.
  • درجة الحرارة: تناسبه درجات الحرارة الداخلية الدافئة تقريباً بين 18 و28 درجة مئوية.
  • الرطوبة: يفضّل رطوبة معتدلة.
  • مستوى العناية: سهل إلى متوسط.
  • العناية في الإمارات: يُبعد عن تيار المكيف المباشر وعن شمس الظهيرة القوية عبر النوافذ.
  • الصيانة: تُمسح الأوراق عند تراكم الغبار ويُربط النمو الجديد بالدعامة عند الحاجة.

الأحجام المتوفرة

  • صغير — 30–40 سم / أصيص مشتل: 77 درهم
  • متوسط — حوالي 40 سم / أصيص بلاستيكي 12 سم: 105 درهم
  • كبير — 65–80 سم / أصيص بلاستيكي 15 سم مع دعامة طحالب: 175 درهم

السلامة

يحتوي النبات على بلورات أوكسالات الكالسيوم وقد يسبب تهيجاً عند المضغ أو الابتلاع، لذلك يُحفظ بعيداً عن الأطفال والحيوانات الأليفة.

اختلاف طبيعي: تختلف النباتات الحية طبيعياً في الارتفاع والكثافة وحجم الأوراق وعدد الشقوق، وقد يختلف النبات المستلم قليلاً عن الصور.

body_html:
Dieffenbachia Green Magic

Dieffenbachia 'Green Magic' is an elegant tropical indoor foliage plant known for its rich green leaves and distinctive light central vein. Its upright growth and clean architectural foliage make it ideal for homes, offices, reception areas and indoor corners.

  • Botanical name: Dieffenbachia oerstedii 'Green Magic'
  • Family: Araceae
  • Plant type: Evergreen tropical indoor foliage plant
  • Light: Medium to bright indirect light. Avoid harsh direct sunlight.
  • Watering: Water when the top 2–3 cm of soil begins to dry. Keep lightly moist but never waterlogged.
  • Humidity: Moderate to high humidity is preferred.
  • Temperature: Warm indoor conditions are best. Protect from cold drafts.
  • Growth habit: Upright and clumping.
  • Care level: Easy to moderate.
  • Best placement: Living rooms, offices, reception areas, desks and indoor corners.
  • UAE care: Keep away from direct air-conditioning vents and strong afternoon sunlight through glass.
  • Safety: Dieffenbachia contains calcium oxalate crystals and is toxic if chewed or ingested. Keep away from pets and small children.

Available Sizes

  • Small — AED 60
  • Medium — AED 120
  • Large — AED 240

Natural variation: Live plants naturally vary in height, fullness, leaf number and shape. The supplied plant may differ slightly from product photography.

ديفنباخيا جرين ماجيك

ديفنباخيا جرين ماجيك نبات استوائي داخلي أنيق يتميز بأوراق خضراء غنية وعِرق وسطي فاتح وواضح. نموه القائم وشكل أوراقه الأنيق يجعلان منه خياراً مناسباً للمنازل والمكاتب والاستقبالات والزوايا الداخلية.

  • الاسم العلمي: Dieffenbachia oerstedii 'Green Magic'
  • الفصيلة: Araceae
  • نوع النبات: نبات ورقي استوائي داخلي دائم الخضرة
  • الإضاءة: إضاءة متوسطة إلى ساطعة غير مباشرة مع تجنب الشمس المباشرة القوية.
  • الري: يُروى عند بدء جفاف أول 2–3 سم من التربة مع تجنب تشبعها بالماء.
  • الرطوبة: يفضّل رطوبة معتدلة إلى مرتفعة.
  • درجة الحرارة: يفضّل الأجواء الداخلية الدافئة مع الحماية من التيارات الباردة.

  • العناية في الإمارات: يُبعد عن فتحات المكيف المباشرة وعن شمس الظهيرة القوية عبر النوافذ.

title: Blue Torch Cactus (Pilosocereus pachycladus) | صبار الشعلة الزرقاء
body_html:
English

Blue Torch Cactus (Pilosocereus pachycladus) is a striking columnar cactus with blue-green stems, prominent ribs and pale spines. Its sculptural upright form makes it an excellent focal plant for bright patios, sunny outdoor spaces and modern desert-style planting.

  • Botanical name: Pilosocereus pachycladus
  • Common name: Blue Torch Cactus / Blue Columnar Cactus
  • Best placement: Sunny patios, balconies, courtyards, gardens and bright outdoor containers
  • Light: Strong light to full sun after gradual acclimation
  • Water: Water thoroughly, then allow the growing mix to dry well before watering again
  • Soil: Fast-draining cactus and succulent mix
  • Care level: Easy to moderate

UAE care note: Acclimate nursery-grown plants gradually to intense UAE sun. Avoid waterlogged soil and handle carefully because of the spines.

Natural variation: Live cacti naturally vary in height, branching, colour and spine pattern. Decorative pots are included only when specifically stated in the selected variant.

العربية

صبار الشعلة الزرقاء (Pilosocereus pachycladus) صبار عمودي مميز بسيقان خضراء مزرقة وأضلاع واضحة وأشواك فاتحة اللون، ويمنح الحدائق والشرفات طابعًا معماريًا عصريًا.

  • الاسم العلمي: Pilosocereus pachycladus
  • الاسم الشائع: صبار الشعلة الزرقاء / الصبار العمودي الأزرق
  • أفضل مكان: الباحات والشرفات والساحات والحدائق والأصص الخارجية المضيئة
  • الإضاءة: إضاءة قوية إلى شمس كاملة بعد التأقلم التدريجي
  • الري: يُروى جيدًا ثم يُترك خليط التربة ليجف قبل الري مرة أخرى
  • التربة: خليط سريع التصريف للصبار والعصاريات
  • مستوى العناية: سهل إلى متوسط

ملاحظة للعناية في الإمارات: يجب تعويد نباتات المشتل تدريجيًا على شمس الإمارات القوية، مع تجنب تشبع التربة بالماء والتعامل بحذر بسبب الأشواك.

اختلاف طبيعي: يختلف الصبار الحي طبيعيًا في الارتفاع والتفرعات واللون ونمط الأشواك. الأصيص الزخرفي مشمول فقط عندما يكون مذكورًا بوضوح ضمن المتغير.

title: Cactus & Succulent Terrarium | تيراريوم الصبار والعصاريات
body_html:
English

A cactus and succulent terrarium combines compact desert-style plants with a decorative glass container. Because market arrangements differ, the exact plant mix, glass shape, stone layers and dimensions should be confirmed for each stocked design.

  • Botanical name: Mixed cactus and succulent species
  • Best placement: Bright indoor spaces away from dark corners
  • Light: Bright light; care depends on the exact plant mix
  • Water: For open cactus/succulent-dominant arrangements, water sparingly and allow the substrate to dry well. Mixed tropical terrariums require different moisture levels.
  • Care level: Varies by arrangement

UAE care note: Do not apply one watering schedule to every terrarium. Confirm the actual plant mix and whether the container is open or closed before publishing a final care card.

Natural variation: Live plants naturally vary in height, fullness, leaf count, colour and shape. Decorative pots are included only when specifically selected as a variant.

العربية

يجمع تيراريوم الصبار والعصاريات بين نباتات صغيرة بطابع صحراوي ووعاء زجاجي زخرفي. تختلف التشكيلات في السوق، لذلك يجب تأكيد نوع النباتات وشكل الزجاج والطبقات والأبعاد لكل تصميم متوفر.

  • الاسم العلمي: Mixed cactus and succulent species
  • أفضل مكان: المساحات الداخلية المضيئة بعيدًا عن الزوايا المظلمة
  • الإضاءة: إضاءة ساطعة، وتختلف متطلبات العناية حسب مكونات التيراريوم
  • الري: في التشكيلات المفتوحة التي يغلب عليها الصبار والعصاريات يكون الري قليلًا مع ترك الوسط ليجف جيدًا، بينما تحتاج التشكيلات الاستوائية إلى رطوبة مختلفة
  • مستوى العناية: يختلف حسب التشكيلة

ملاحظة للعناية في الإمارات: لا تستخدم جدول ري واحدًا لجميع أنواع التيراريوم. يجب تأكيد مكونات النباتات وما إذا كان الوعاء مفتوحًا أو مغلقًا قبل نشر بطاقة العناية النهائية.

اختلاف طبيعي: النباتات الحية تختلف طبيعيًا في الارتفاع والكثافة وعدد الأوراق واللون والشكل. الأصيص الزخرفي مشمول فقط عند اختياره بوضوح ضمن المتغير.

title: Mixed Echeveria Succulents (Echeveria sp.) | عصاريات إشفيريا متنوعة
body_html:
English

A mixed Echeveria bundle combines compact rosette-form succulents for desks, windowsills, gifts and grouped displays. The exact colours and species/cultivars in a mixed bundle naturally vary.

  • Botanical name: Echeveria spp.
  • Best placement: Very bright windows, sunny indoor spots and protected bright balconies
  • Light: Very bright light; introduce direct sun gradually
  • Water: Allow the potting mix to dry fully between thorough waterings
  • Care level: Easy

UAE care note: Use a fast-draining succulent mix. Avoid frequent watering in air-conditioned interiors and acclimate plants gradually before strong outdoor UAE sun.

Natural variation: Live plants naturally vary in height, fullness, leaf count, colour and shape. Decorative pots are included only when specifically selected as a variant.

العربية

مجموعة إشفيريا متنوعة تضم عصاريات صغيرة على شكل وردات، مناسبة للطاولات وحواف النوافذ والهدايا والعروض المجمعة. تختلف الألوان والأنواع والأصناف داخل المجموعة بشكل طبيعي.

  • الاسم العلمي: Echeveria spp.
  • أفضل مكان: النوافذ شديدة الإضاءة والأماكن الداخلية المشمسة والشرفات المضيئة المحمية
  • الإضاءة: إضاءة قوية جدًا مع تعويد النبات على الشمس المباشرة تدريجيًا
  • الري: تُترك التربة لتجف بالكامل بين مرات الري الجيد
  • مستوى العناية: سهل

ملاحظة للعناية في الإمارات: استخدم خليط تربة سريع التصريف للعصاريات، وتجنب الري المتكرر داخل الأماكن المكيفة، وعرّض النباتات للشمس الخارجية القوية في الإمارات تدريجيًا.

اختلاف طبيعي: النباتات الحية تختلف طبيعيًا في الارتفاع والكثافة وعدد الأوراق واللون والشكل. الأصيص الزخرفي مشمول فقط عند اختياره بوضوح ضمن المتغير.

title: Arabian Coffee Plant (Coffea arabica) | نبتة القهوة العربية
body_html:
English

Coffea arabica is a glossy-leaved tropical coffee plant that makes an attractive foliage specimen indoors. Young plants are compact and work well on bright desks and shelves.

  • Botanical name: Coffea arabica
  • Best placement: Bright living rooms, offices, desks and protected indoor spaces
  • Light: Bright indirect light; avoid harsh UAE afternoon sun through glass
  • Water: Keep lightly moist, allowing the surface to begin drying between waterings; never leave standing in water
  • Care level: Moderate

UAE care note: Keep away from strong AC vents and sudden temperature changes. Moderate humidity supports healthier foliage.

Natural variation: Live plants naturally vary in height, fullness, leaf count, colour and shape. Decorative pots are included only when specifically selected as a variant.

العربية

نبتة القهوة العربية ذات أوراق خضراء لامعة وهي نبات استوائي جذاب للاستخدام الداخلي، وتكون النباتات الصغيرة مناسبة للطاولات والرفوف المضيئة.

  • الاسم العلمي: Coffea arabica
  • أفضل مكان: غرف المعيشة والمكاتب والطاولات والمساحات الداخلية المحمية والمضيئة
  • الإضاءة: إضاءة ساطعة غير مباشرة مع تجنب شمس الظهيرة القوية عبر الزجاج
  • الري: تُحافظ التربة على رطوبة خفيفة مع السماح لسطحها بالبدء في الجفاف بين مرات الري، من دون ترك الماء راكدًا
  • مستوى العناية: متوسط

ملاحظة للعناية في الإمارات: يُبعد عن فتحات المكيف القوية والتغيرات المفاجئة في الحرارة، كما تساعد الرطوبة المعتدلة على جودة الأوراق.

اختلاف طبيعي: النباتات الحية تختلف طبيعيًا في الارتفاع والكثافة وعدد الأوراق واللون والشكل. الأصيص الزخرفي مشمول فقط عند اختياره بوضوح ضمن المتغير.

title: Panda Plant (Kalanchoe tomentosa) | نبتة الباندا (كالانشو تومينتوسا)
body_html:
English

Panda Plant is a compact succulent recognised by its soft, velvety leaves and contrasting brown-edged tips. Its texture makes it a distinctive tabletop plant for bright interiors.

  • Botanical name: Kalanchoe tomentosa
  • Best placement: Bright windowsills, desks and shelves
  • Light: Very bright indirect light with some gentle sun after acclimation
  • Water: Let the potting mix dry well between waterings
  • Care level: Easy

UAE care note: Use a fast-draining succulent mix and avoid frequent watering in air-conditioned interiors.

Natural variation: Live plants naturally vary in height, fullness, leaf count, colour and shape. Decorative pots are included only when specifically selected as a variant.

العربية

نبتة الباندا عصارية صغيرة تتميز بأوراق مخملية ناعمة وحواف بنية واضحة، ما يمنحها شكلاً مميزًا للطاولات والرفوف المضيئة.

  • الاسم العلمي: Kalanchoe tomentosa
  • أفضل مكان: حواف النوافذ المضيئة والطاولات والرفوف
  • الإضاءة: إضاءة قوية غير مباشرة مع إمكانية تعريضها لشمس لطيفة بعد التأقلم
  • الري: تُترك التربة لتجف جيدًا بين مرات الري
  • مستوى العناية: سهل

ملاحظة للعناية في الإمارات: استخدم خليط تربة سريع التصريف للعصاريات وتجنب الإفراط في الري داخل المساحات المكيفة.

اختلاف طبيعي: النباتات الحية تختلف طبيعيًا في الارتفاع والكثافة وعدد الأوراق واللون والشكل. الأصيص الزخرفي مشمول فقط عند اختياره بوضوح ضمن المتغير.

title: Variegated Creeping Fig (Ficus pumila 'Variegata') | فيكس بوميلا مبرقش
body_html:
English

Ficus pumila 'Variegata' is a small-leaved trailing and climbing fig with green-and-cream variegation. It can be trained on supports or allowed to trail from a container.

  • Botanical name: Ficus pumila 'Variegata'
  • Best placement: Bright indoor spaces, hanging pots, trellises and green-wall style displays
  • Light: Bright indirect light; some softer morning light can be suitable
  • Water: Water when the soil surface starts to dry; avoid prolonged waterlogging
  • Care level: Moderate

UAE care note: Protect indoor plants from harsh afternoon sun through glass and from direct AC drafts.

Natural variation: Live plants naturally vary in height, fullness, leaf count, colour and shape. Decorative pots are included only when specifically selected as a variant.

العربية

فيكس بوميلا المبرقش نبات متسلق ومتدلٍ بأوراق صغيرة تجمع بين الأخضر واللون الكريمي، ويمكن توجيهه على دعامات أو تركه يتدلى من الأصيص.

  • الاسم العلمي: Ficus pumila 'Variegata'
  • أفضل مكان: المساحات الداخلية المضيئة والأصص المعلقة والتعريشات والجدران الخضراء
  • الإضاءة: إضاءة ساطعة غير مباشرة ويمكنه الاستفادة من شمس صباحية لطيفة
  • الري: يُروى عند بدء جفاف سطح التربة مع تجنب بقاء التربة مشبعة بالماء
  • مستوى العناية: متوسط

ملاحظة للعناية في الإمارات: يجب حمايته من شمس الظهيرة القوية عبر الزجاج ومن تيار المكيف المباشر.

اختلاف طبيعي: النباتات الحية تختلف طبيعيًا في الارتفاع والكثافة وعدد الأوراق واللون والشكل. الأصيص الزخرفي مشمول فقط عند اختياره بوضوح ضمن المتغير.

title: Snake Plant Laurentii - Sansevieria Trifasciata
body_html:

  • Available heights: 20–30 cm, 40–60 cm and 60–80 cm
  • Growth habit: Upright, architectural and slow-growing
  • Light: Low to bright indirect light
  • Watering: Allow the soil to dry thoroughly between waterings
  • Care level: Easy
  • Best for: Bedrooms, living rooms, offices, receptions and floor displays

Benefits: The strong yellow-edged foliage adds contrast and height while remaining highly tolerant of typical indoor conditions and irregular watering.

body_html:
African Spear - Sansevieria Cylindrica is a hardy architectural plant with thick, smooth cylindrical leaves rising vertically from the base.

  • Approximate height: 25–35 cm
  • Growth habit: Upright, spear-form and slow-growing
  • Light: Medium to bright indirect light; tolerates lower light
  • Watering: Water sparingly and let the soil dry between waterings
  • Care level: Easy
  • Best for: Homes, offices, desks and minimal contemporary interiors

Bird's Nest Snake Plant - Hahnii is a compact Sansevieria with short, broad leaves arranged in a dense rosette resembling a bird's nest.

  • Botanical name: Dracaena trifasciata 'Hahnii'
  • Growth habit: Compact, low-growing rosette
  • Light: Low to bright indirect light
  • Watering: Allow the soil to dry well between waterings
  • Care level: Easy
  • Best for: Desks, shelves, bedside tables and small indoor spaces

Benefits: Its compact shape delivers the architectural look of a snake plant without taking up much space.

title: Ficus Lyrata - Fiddle Leaf Fig
body_html:
Ficus Lyrata - Fiddle Leaf Fig is a premium indoor foliage plant known for its large, glossy, violin-shaped leaves and strong architectural form.

  • Botanical name: Ficus lyrata
  • Available heights: 40–60 cm, 70–90 cm, 100–130 cm, 140–155 cm and 160–175 cm
  • Growth habit: Upright, tree-form evergreen foliage plant
  • Light: Bright indirect light; place near a bright window while avoiding harsh direct afternoon sun
  • Watering: Water when the upper layer of soil begins to dry. Avoid overwatering and standing water
  • Humidity: Prefers moderate humidity and stable indoor conditions
  • Care level: Moderate
  • Best for: Living rooms, offices, reception areas, hallways and statement interior corners
  • Pet note: Keep away from pets and children if chewed or ingested

Benefits: Its oversized sculptural foliage creates an immediate focal point and adds height, texture and a premium tropical look to interiors. Multiple plant heights allow it to work as a tabletop accent, medium floor plant or large statement tree.

title: ZZ Plant - Zamioculcas Zamiifolia, Zanzibar Gem
body_html:
ZZ Plant (Zamioculcas zamiifolia), also known as the Zanzibar Gem, is a hardy evergreen houseplant with upright stems and glossy dark-green leaflets.

  • Botanical name: Zamioculcas zamiifolia
  • Available heights: 30–40 cm, 50–70 cm and 80–100 cm
  • Growth habit: Upright, clump-forming and slow to moderate growing
  • Light: Low to bright indirect light; avoid strong direct sun
  • Watering: Allow the soil to dry well between waterings; avoid overwatering
  • Care level: Easy
  • Best for: Living rooms, bedrooms, offices, reception areas and low-maintenance indoor displays
  • Pet note: Keep away from pets and children if chewed or ingested

Benefits: The ZZ Plant is valued for its glossy evergreen foliage, strong architectural form and excellent tolerance of lower light and irregular watering. The different height options make it suitable for desks, tabletop arrangements and larger floor-standing displays.

title: Peace Lily - Spathiphyllum
body_html:
Peace Lily (Spathiphyllum) is an elegant evergreen flowering houseplant with glossy deep-green foliage and graceful white blooms held above the leaves.

  • Botanical name: Spathiphyllum spp.
  • Available heights: 25–35 cm, 45–60 cm, 70–80 cm, 90–120 cm and 130–140 cm
  • Growth habit: Upright, clump-forming evergreen foliage plant
  • Light: Medium to bright indirect light; it can adapt to lower indoor light
  • Watering: Keep the soil lightly moist, allowing the upper layer to dry slightly between waterings
  • Humidity: Prefers moderate to higher humidity
  • Care level: Easy to Moderate
  • Best for: Living rooms, bedrooms, offices, reception areas and indoor flowering displays
  • Pet note: Keep away from pets and children if chewed or ingested

Benefits: Peace Lily combines attractive glossy foliage with elegant white flowers and performs well in many indoor environments. Multiple height options make it suitable for desks, tabletop displays, floor-standing arrangements and larger office or reception spaces. Flowering stage and number of blooms may vary naturally with season and growing conditions.

title: Pachira Aquatica - Money Tree (Twisted Trunk)
body_html:
Pachira Aquatica - Money Tree (Twisted Trunk) is an attractive indoor tree with glossy green leaves and a distinctive braided trunk. Its upright shape makes it a strong decorative choice for homes, offices, reception areas and gifting.

  • Botanical name: Pachira aquatica
  • Available heights: 30-40cm, 50-70cm, 80-110cm, 130-150cm and 160-190cm
  • Growth habit: Upright indoor tree with braided/twisted trunk
  • Light: Bright indirect light; avoid harsh direct sunlight
  • Watering: Water thoroughly, then allow the upper 2-4cm of soil to dry before watering again
  • Humidity: Moderate to high humidity is preferred
  • Temperature: Best in normal warm indoor conditions around 16-24°C
  • Soil: Well-draining indoor potting mix
  • Care level: Easy to Moderate
  • Best for: Living rooms, offices, reception areas, entrances and gifts

Benefits: The twisted trunk creates a premium decorative look while the upright form adds height without taking up excessive floor space. Pachira aquatica is also commonly associated with prosperity in Feng Shui traditions.
product_type: Plant, Indoor Plant, Office, Evergreen, Easy Care

title: Madagascar Jasmine - Stephanotis Floribunda
body_html:
Madagascar Jasmine (Stephanotis floribunda) is an elegant evergreen flowering climber with glossy dark-green leaves and clusters of waxy, star-shaped white flowers known for their rich sweet fragrance.

  • Botanical name: Stephanotis floribunda
  • Available sizes: 30–40 cm, 50–70 cm and 70–90 cm
  • Growth habit: Evergreen climbing vine that can be trained around a hoop, trellis or other support
  • Light: Bright indoor light or bright indirect sunlight
  • Watering: Water when the upper layer of soil begins to dry; keep lightly moist but never waterlogged
  • Temperature: Prefers warm indoor conditions and protection from sudden temperature changes
  • Humidity: Moderate to high humidity is preferred
  • Care level: Moderate
  • Best for: Living rooms, bright offices, windowside displays, entrances and flowering indoor collections

Benefits: Fragrant white flowers, glossy evergreen foliage and a graceful climbing form create a premium decorative display. Larger sizes provide a fuller, more established appearance for statement spaces. Flowering stage and number of blooms may vary naturally by season.

title: Croton Gold Star - Codiaeum Variegatum 'Gold Star'
body_html:
Croton Gold Star is a distinctive croton cultivar with narrow glossy green leaves covered in bright golden-yellow speckles.

  • Available size: 30 - 40 CM

title: Dracaena Lemon Lime - Evergreen Indoor Plant
body_html:
Dracaena Lemon Lime features long striped leaves in fresh shades of deep green, lime and yellow for a bright modern foliage display.

  • Botanical name: Dracaena fragrans 'Lemon Lime'
  • Available size: 100 - 120 CM, 120 - 150 CM, 150 - 180 CM
  • Growth habit: Upright cane-form growth with arching leaves.
  • Light: Medium to bright indirect light; can adapt to lower indoor light.
  • Watering: Allow the upper portion of the soil to dry before watering again.
  • Care level: Easy
  • Pet note: Keep away from pets if chewed.
  • Best for: Living rooms, offices, reception areas, bedrooms and commercial interiors.

Benefits: The bright striped foliage adds color without flowers, while its upright form makes it useful for adding height to indoor spaces.

title: Dracaena Massangeana - Dracaena Fragrans
body_html:
Dracaena Massangeana is a classic cane-form indoor plant with long arching green leaves marked by a broad yellow-green central stripe.

  • Botanical name: Dracaena fragrans 'Massangeana'
  • Available size: 80 - 100 CM, 100 - 120 CM, 120 - 150 CM, 150 - 180 CM,
  • Growth habit: Upright cane-form growth with a full crown of arching leaves.
  • Light: Low to bright indirect light; best growth occurs in medium to bright filtered light.
  • Watering: Allow part of the soil to dry between waterings and avoid overwatering.
  • Care level: Easy
  • Pet note: Keep away from pets if chewed.
  • Best for: Large living rooms, offices, reception areas, hallways and commercial interiors.

Benefits: Its tall vertical shape adds height and greenery while taking up relatively little floor space, making it suitable for both homes and professional interiors.

title: Rubber Plant - Ficus Elastica
body_html:
Rubber Plant - Ficus Elastica is an upright indoor tree with broad, thick and glossy leaves that create a clean architectural look.

  • Botanical name: Ficus elastica
  • Available size:  80 - 100 CM
  • Growth habit: Upright, tree-form growth with a strong central stem.
  • Light: Bright indirect light; established plants can adapt to medium indirect light.
  • Watering: Allow the upper portion of the soil to dry before watering again.
  • Care level: Easy to Moderate
  • Pet note: Keep away from pets if chewed.
  • Best for: Living rooms, offices, reception areas and larger indoor corners.

Benefits: Large glossy leaves give immediate visual impact, while the upright form is ideal for adding height and greenery without a wide footprint.

title: African Mask Plant - Alocasia 'Polly'
body_html:

  • Available size: 30 - 40 CM
  • Growth habit: Compact, upright and architectural.
  • Light: Bright indirect light; avoid strong direct afternoon sun.
  • Watering: Keep the soil lightly moist during active growth but never waterlogged.
  • Care level: Moderate
  • Humidity: Prefers moderate to high humidity.
  • Pet note: Keep away from pets if chewed.
  • Best for: Statement corners, side tables, living rooms and bright indoor displays.

Benefits: Its sculptural foliage creates a strong premium focal point without requiring the floor space of a large indoor tree.

title: Croton Plant - Codiaeum Variegatum

  • Pet note: Keep away from pets if chewed.
  • Best for: Bright living rooms, entrances, covered patios and well-lit offices.

Benefits: Bold multicolored foliage creates an instant focal point and adds strong tropical character to interior and sheltered outdoor settings.

title: Golden Pothos - Epipremnum Aureum

  • Pet note: Not suitable for pets to chew.
  • Best for: Hanging planters, shelves, offices, living rooms, kitchens and indoor climbing displays.

  • Light: Medium to bright indirect light; tolerates lower light but may grow more slowly.

  • Care level: Easy
  • Pet note: Not suitable for pets to chew.
  • Best for: Hanging baskets, shelves, desks and indoor climbing displays.

title: Silver Queen - Aglaonema Commutatum 'Silver Queen'

  • Pet note: Keep away from pets if chewed.
  • Best for: Bedrooms, living rooms, reception areas, desks and offices.

title: Pine Bark Mulch Per KG
body_html: Pine Bark Mulch mulch can benefit soil and plants in many ways. Mulch insulates the soil and plants in winter but also keeps the soil cool and moist in summer. Mulch can control weeds and erosion. It also helps to retain soil moisture and prevent splash back of soil that can contain soil-borne fungus and diseases.

title: Pine Bark Nugget, 45Ltr Bag
body_html:
Ease of application is the strong suit of pine bark nugget mulches.  Pine bark nuggets come in several different size grades, from “mini” to “jumbo” nuggets. (Soil conditioner is a ground pine bark product smaller than mini-nuggets that can also be used as mulch.) Pine bark is long lasting, and when it does break down it enriches the soil with organic material.  Water pooling can cause bark nuggets to float and spread, and moving water can cause it to wash away, requiring it be raked back or replaced entirely.  This makes bark nuggets less suitable for areas that tend to get flowing water in heavy rains.

  • Enough to spread on 1.0- 2.0m Area.
  • Packing: 45 ltr bag, around 5-7kg

Flowers flushed purple in bud opening white in clusters. Jasminum grandiflora Or Jasmine Climber is vigorous, twining, woody, deciduous, occasionally semi-deciduous climber with opposite, pinnate, mid-green leaves composed of 5-9 elliptic leaflets, to 6cm long, with long, sharp points. Quisqualis indica Or Rangoon Creeper is freely branching, perennial climber, erect and shrub-like when young. Mid- to deep green leaves, 8-18cm long, are elliptic to elliptic-oblong with rounded to heart-shaped bases, long, sharp tips, and prominent veins. In summer and autumn, bears slender-tubed, fragrant flowers, 4-7cm long, with 5 spreading lobes, in pendent, terminal racemes, 10cm long; initially white, they change to pink and purplish red then bright red over a 3-day period.

Carissa grandiflora ‘Prostrata’ (Natal Plum) is many-branched, spiny shrub with ovate, rich green leaves, to 7cm long. Fragrant, waxy, white, jasmine-like flowers, 5cm wide, are borne in terminal or axillary cymes, to 10cm long, in late spring; they are followed by plum-like, ovoid-ellipsoid, red to purple-black fruit, 5cm long. Height 2-3m or more, Spread 3m or more. Native of S. Africa. Various cultivars have been selected, including ‘Fancy’, which is erect and very free-flowering, with glossy, dark green leaves and orange-red fruit, and ‘Tuttlei’ which is dwarf, prostrate, and dense, and useful as ground cover or for containers.

title: Venus Flytrap , Dionaea Muscipula
body_html:
This Venus Flytrap, Dionaea Muscipula, is a unique variety of carnivorous plant native to subtropical wetlands on the East Coast of the United States. The plant's distinct trapping mechanism, triggered by insects, is highly adapted for nutrient-poor environments. Dionaea Muscipula is easy to care for and is ideal for novice gardeners.

The Venus Flytrap (Dionea Miscupula) catches small insects such as mosquitoes and flies by closing its leaves on them. As soon as they feel the insect land on their leaves, they will close them up.

This is a fascinating plant, which will eat flies! Its leaves are modified, so grow to develop spiny traps at their tips. These are red-flushed or green in colour, and are designed to snap shut when an insect (attracted by the plant’s nectar) sits inside. Tempting as it may be, you should avoid setting off the traps by touching them yourself, as each trap will only activate two to three times before it dies back. These will get replaced, but if the plant does not get the chance to absorb the nutrients from the insect, it may become weakened over time.

title: American Pitchers , Sarracenia
body_html:
*Price is for one plant with pot

Sarracenia are commonly known as Pitcher Plants or Trumpet Pitchers and can be long-lived and easy houseplants to grow and keep looking attractive from one year to the next.

The American Pitcher is an iconic Sarracenia species whose remarkable leaves and stems make it an ideal choice for any garden. With a tall, upright growth habit and vibrant colors, it's sure to make a statement in any outdoor space. Its leaf tips also produce a delightful fragrance to attract beneficial insects.

They capture insects by producing nectar along the rim of their pitchers. When an insect starts to lick up the nectar, it tries to get more by reaching in the pitcher. When it loses its footing, it falls right in. The inside walls of the pitcher are very smooth, so insects are not able to crawl out. They also can’t fly out because there isn’t any airlift in a tube! Eventually the insect dies, and as it decomposes, the plant absorbs its nutrients right through its leaves

  • Pitcher Plants loves bright sunlight. Min 6 hours indirect in UAE. Do not place it outside in direct sun.
  • The pot with the plant must always be sitting in pure water. It likes mineral free and low TDS water, If the TDS is higher than 100, use distilled, reverse osmosis, or clean rain water.
  • Feeding: Do not fertilize or give meat! Left outdoors in shaded area, Sarracenia feed themselves.

title: Monkey Jar , Nepenthes

And while monkeys (and people!) can get up close and personal to appreciate them, insects attracted to the nectar and bright colors of the pitchers are swallowed up and digested by the trap.

The Monkey Jar Nepenthes is a unique, low-maintenance, carnivorous plant species. It features an attractive spherical shape and bright red color, producing a unique and aesthetically pleasing addition to any garden. Its lid-like shape traps and digests insects, making it an efficient bug-killing solution.

Monkey Jars are pretty much maintenance-free.

title: Butterworts , Sarracenia pinguicula
body_html:
Their arthropodicidal nature becomes clear only when you look very closely at the leaves. For there, adhering to the glandular surface of the leaf, are countless tiny little gnats and other minute arthropods. They are not only stuck to the leaf—they are drowned in moist pools of slime, and are indeed being digested.

Butterworts are fascinating carnivorous plants that trap and digest small insects using their sticky, glandular leaves. The leaf surface secretes a moist, adhesive substance that ensnares tiny gnats and arthropods, which are then slowly digested by the plant. These unique plants thrive in humid conditions and make captivating additions to any plant collection. Perfect for those interested in exotic, low-maintenance carnivorous species that naturally control indoor pests.

These plants do need a humid environment to thrive, so a bright bathroom or steamy kitchen would be ideal. Very prolific Ionanthas that quickly form into a bigger ball.  They are really very hardy, and require much less attention than other house plants.

When the plant is about to bloom, it changes to shades of vibrant deep red to orange and eventually displays yellow/purple/white tubular flowers. Ionantha blooms 2 or 3 times a year. It creates many offsets or pups which will clump into a ball as it matures.

title: Tillandsia Bulbosa, Air Plant

The leaves can turn from green to bright red when the Bulbosa is about to bloom beautiful tubular bright purple flowers. Air Plant Tillandsia Bulbosa, take on many different shapes and sizes depending on their species. The leaves are narrow and curled in at the edges to produce straw-like tubes, which are oddly twisted and contorted, giving plants a rather weird appearance.

  • Watering: Every one to two weeks, soak your air plant in room temperature tap water. After soaking gently shake excess water from your plant. Turn it upside down and place it on a towel in a bright space.

title: Phoenix Roebelenii, Miniature Date Palm, Dwarf Pygmy Date palm
body_html:
Max Height: 2m Spread: 2.5m

Origin: Laos Family: Arecaceae/ Palmae

Common Name: Miniature Date Palm, Pygmy Date Palm Flower Colour: Cream

Drought Tolerance: High Salinity Tolerance: High

Sun Tolerance: High Wind Tolerance: High

Water Requirement: Low PH Level: Basic

Pest Tolerance: Medium Disease Tolerance: High

Growth rate: Slow Fragrance: No

Phoenix is a dwarf palm or Miniature Date Palm with a slender trunk, occasionally clustered, bearing pinnately-divided leaves to 1m in length; panicles of small yellow flowers may be followed by small edible black fruit. Lovely as an indoor plant.

The pygmy date palm grows very slowly, reaching a maximum height indoors of  4-5 ft. (1-2 meters). This palm produces arching, graceful fronds about 3ft. or 0.9 meters in length with delicate leaflets on them. These fronds develop off of a stately central trunk. Like most palms, the dwarf date palm is an excellent clean air plant.

Elegantly shimmering in the sunlight, this tropical cluster of long arching fronds calmly drapes your interior with a soothing tranquillity. Like its cousin the Canariensis, Phoenix roebelenii is a hardy majestic palm suitable for both indoor and outdoor spaces, its feathery leaves reminiscent of warmer days spent in exotic places.

Palm with intriguing leaves resembling the tail of a fish, which is how this plant got its common name. In a home environment, these palms will grow as tall as space allows. fishtail palm most commonly sold for houseplant and landscape use. It’s probably one of the most elegant looking palms, bringing an upscale look to any room or garden.

Caryota mitis or fishtail palm نخيل ذيل السمكة is small to medium-sized palm with clustered stems, at first clothed with fibrous leaf bases, later bare. body_html:
One of the most popular forms of Tillandsia, plants that are part of the Bromeliad family, which contains more than 400 members. The pink quill, Tillansia cyanea, is the most commonly cultivated species.

Arching, narrow green leaves grow in a rosette with flower spikes appearing in summer. Its pink bracts are densely overlapping, with violet-blue flowers emerging for a brief show.

  • Watering: Pour 1 cup or 200ml every 3 days only when the soil begins to dry out. Water in the early morning or late evening when temperatures are cooler
  • Light: Bright indoor light or indirect sun. 6 hours to 8 hours
  • Temperature:18°C to 25°C
  • Fertilizer: NPK Fertilizer Tabs or Baby Bio Plant Food or Fast Green Fertilizer

title: Daffodil Narcissus - Seasonal Flowering Bulb Plant
body_html:
Daffodil / Narcissus is a seasonal flowering bulb plant with upright green leaves and cheerful trumpet- or cup-shaped blooms. Flower colour can vary by variety, including yellow, white and cream tones.

  • Botanical name: Narcissus spp.
  • Size: Approximately 15–25 cm
  • Growth habit: Upright bulbous flowering plant
  • Light: Bright light to partial sun
  • Watering: Keep the soil moderately moist while actively growing and flowering; reduce watering after flowering as the bulb enters dormancy
  • Care level: Easy to Moderate
  • Best for: Bright indoor displays, balconies, patios and seasonal flowering arrangements

Benefits: Compact growth and bright seasonal flowers add fresh colour to small spaces, tabletops and balcony displays. Some Narcissus varieties are also pleasantly fragrant. Flowering stage and flower colour may vary seasonally.

title: Money Tree, Crassula ovata, Dollar Plant, Jade Tree
body_html:
An attractive, sculptural, evergreen, succulent sub-shrub with branches carrying oval-shaped, glossy, dark green leaves, edged with red. Crassula ovata is slow-growing, and perfect for indoor containers. It produces clusters of small, star-shaped, white or light pink flowers, in late summer.

Crassula ovata known as Dollar Plant, Jade Plant, Jade Tree, Money True. Erect, many-branched, succulent shrub with a thick, fleshy stem and elliptic, glossy, mid-green leaves, sometimes red-margined, 2-4cm long. Bears star-shaped, white to pale pink flowers, to 8mm across, in autumn. Height 2m or more, Spread 1m or more.

Once established as a mature plant, it forms a miniature tree like structure, with a thick trunk and branches. Leaves are thick, fleshy and opal shaped in a deep, glossy jade green, sometimes with a red tinge at the leaf edge. New growth starts on stems that have the same colour and texture as the leaves, but this hardens into a brown, woody stem in time.

title: String of Pearls, Senecio Rowleyanus
body_html:
An unusual succulent, Senecio rowleyanus, or String of Pearls, has long vines with nearly spherical leaves cascading from it’s stem. It is an eye-catcher and conversation starter! The multiple masses of trailing stems with almost perfect spherical beads every few inches are very cool to see. Plus, it’s fun to say that you have multiple strings of pearls on your plant stand.

They get their common name, String of Pearls, Peas or Beads from these round leaves that appear like little green peas. These round pea-like leaves store water, giving them their drought tolerant, succulent nature. The little round leaves also have ‘windows’, which appear like little slits in the center of the leaves. These windows let the light in for photosynthesis.

  • Water string of pearls thoroughly and allow the potting mixture to dry completely before watering the plant again. Monitor the soil of outdoor plants and water when it becomes dry.
  • Place string of pearls in a bright, sunny window, preferably a window.
  • Provide water sparingly during winter months. Water the plant just enough to moist the potting soil in winter.
  • Fertilize string of pearls every alternative week during spring and summer. Use a general-purpose liquid houseplant fertilizer.
  • Place string of pearls plants in average room temperatures.
  • String of pearls are not usually susceptible to plant pests or diseases, but mealybugs and aphids may occasionally become a problem. Use a forceful spray of water or an insecticidal soap to remove these pests.

title: Touch me not, Mimosa Pudica
body_html:
If you touch the leaves of this mimosa, it immediately folds up all of its foliage. To predators, it immediately looks like old, dried-up, unlucky green stuff and is not eaten. After about half an hour, the plant has built up the correct cell pressure and is back to normal.

Mimosa pudica, In Latin pudica means shy, bashful or shrinking. Mimosa is also called sensitive plant, sleepy plant, action plant, touch-me-not, shameplant. Mimosa is a creeping annual or perennial flowering plant of the pea/legume family Fabaceae. It is often grown for its curiosity value: the compound leaves fold inward and droop when touched or shaken, defending themselves from harm, and re-open a few minutes later.

  • Use Well-draining loamy soil for ideal results.
  • Likes to be in bright light, ideally by windows.
  • Pudica doesn’t like heat, keep it temperatures below 30 Celsius.
  • Sensitive plant likes to have high humidity, which means spray water on leaves regularly.
  • Keep soil Consistently moist but not soggy.
  • Diluted high-potassium liquid fertilizer every two weeks

The Green Lady Boston Fern is an elegant plant, sometimes called the Sword fern and closely related to the Boston Fern. It is clump forming with graceful, arching fronds with a ruffled appearance that is best displayed in a hanging basket or on a stand where it can cascade over the edge. The Green Lady Boston Fern will not only bring an air of calm to your home, it is one of the best known plants for purifying the air and regulating humidity.

Perfect for the office environment where it helps to absorb radioactivity and static energy created by digital equipment and computers. Likes a shady position indoors. This plant will trap significant levels of potentially damaging toxic particles from its surroundings. It also gives out oxygen. The Sword fern also helps to humidify a room so the indoor climate is improved. Easy to care for, just water regularly and feed during the growing season (March to September). Considered to be non-toxic to pets.

Otherwise known as the pancake plant, UFO plant, missionary plant is the perfect addition to your collection. Pilea peperomioides is a delightful little succulent, with smooth, round, fleshy, mid-green leaves on long stalks. body_html:
15 – 25cm spread.

Ceropegia Woodii is a trailing succulent with purple stems that are long and slender. title: Alocasia Polly ,Elephant Ear, African Shield
body_html:
Size : 35cm-45cm

The Alocasia Polly is a plant with distinct dark green leaves and veins of white colour on top. Commonly known as the African Mask Plant, this is a unique looking, attractive houseplant which comes from the Alocasia genus. Placing the Polly in partial shade and in well-drained, moist soil are key recommendations for this plant, whilst it also prefers places with higher humidity, making bathrooms the perfect indoor environment. African Mask, alocasia colorations, leaf patterns, and overall plant size vary greatly by cultivar. Alocasia is a tropical plant that is increasingly becoming popular as houseplants.

Part of the popular Elephant's Ear (Alocasia) family, The Polly is beautiful, elegant, and incredibly easy to maintain as a houseplant. This stunner will grow a thick trunk in time and will increase the size of its leaves, but will not get as large as its relative, the Amazonica, making it a great show stopper for smaller spaces.

Keep your Elephants Ear Polly houseplant in a warm well-lit space and provide it with evenly moist soil and some humidity to keep it looking fabulous all year round. Pair with a gorgeous planter of choice and use it as a tabletop accent piece or an ornamental space filler on a curated shelf.
product_type: Plant, Indoor Plant, Office, Evergreen, Air Purifying

title: Asparagus Fern
body_html:
20 - 30cm

The Asparagus Fern is a low-maintenance hardy plant. Its delicate, fine foliage works to filter toxins from the air, making it an ideal choice for indoor décor. Its rapid growth allows it to reach up to one meter in height.

The feathery, rich green foliage provide soft texture and a light, airy appearance. An easy-to-grow plant that tolerates changes in watering frequency and is very low maintenance. Protect from harsh afternoon sun for the best appearance. Asparagus fern is a sturdy faker. It is not related to asparagus (in fact, it’s poisonous) and isn’t a fern (it spreads by seeds, not spores). Rather, it’s a quick-growing tropical perennial that’s virtually indestructible as a houseplant.

Asparagus ferns climb, trail, or sit upright, which makes them very flexible plants in a planting scheme (indoors or out). Asparagus plumosus, an aggressive climber, can be snipped for arrangements (pick mature shoots for longevity). The tentacles of foxtail fern, Asparagus densiflorus ‘Myers’, add texture and structure to a perennial bed. Beware: Several varieties are considered invasive outdoors.
product_type: Plant, Indoor Plant, outdoor plant, Office, Evergreen, Air Purifying

The Calathea also known by the name ‘Zebra Plant’ نبات زيبرا , ‘Peacock Plant’, or ‘Rattlesnack Plant’ because of its leaf markings. Displaying lush velvety oval shaped leaves, very similar in shape and size as the Rose painted calathea although usually longer and thinner in width. Named zebra plant because of its striped patterned leaves.

title: Bird’s Nest Fern, Asplenium Nidus
body_html:
40 - 50 cm Spread

The Bird's Nest Fern, Asplenium Nidus, is an easy to care for and highly resilient plant. Its unique fronds are tough, durable, and have an upright, fan-like shape. It prefers diffused sunlight and high humidity, making it perfect for bathrooms or a spot in a temperate terrarium.

The Bird's Nest Fern or Asplenium nidus is one of the several popular and beautiful ferns grown as houseplants. Ferns like this one can be grown in North facing windows perfectly well and will truly relish the type of light and cooler temperatures these places receive.

This interesting plant does not have typical fern fonds, but instead has solid
tongue-shaped fronds that come up from a central rosette. This evergreen fern belongs to group known as bird’s nest. In Japanese language its known as tani-watari. It has bright green, arching blades with a pointed end and a strong midrib.

title: Polka Dot begonia, Begonia Maculata

The Polka Dot Begonia, also known as Begonia Maculata, is an attractive and unique addition to any garden. It has thick, large, green and copper leaves with white spots concentrated mostly on the top side, creating a beautiful contrast and eye-catching effect. The foliage is low-maintenance and requires minimal care.

This stunning Begonia brings colour, texture and pattern to the houseplant table - A triple threat we say!  With long dark green foliage that is spotted with silver and has a burgundy underside; its stems can grow up to 1m tall!  It will sometimes bear small clusters insignificant blooms in pale-pink or white.

Begonia Maculata commonly known as the Polka dot Begonia, is undoubtedly one of the most gorgeous species of indoor plants. This exotic plant derives its name from its unique silver spotted leaves and red undersides. In fact, it is rumoured that Christian Louboutin created his trademark red-heeled shoe to mimic the undersides of the Begonia Maculata. So, it shouldn’t be surprising to hear that this plant requires specialized attention and care.

title: Aglaonema sp, Lady Valentine

*** 30 - 40 cm

The Aglaonema sp, Lady Valentine is a striking houseplant with vibrant pink and green foliage. Its open, upright form adds character to any space, and it requires only minimal care - perfect for busy households. Its glossy foliage requires good light to maintain its vibrant tones, so it's best placed in a sunny spot.

They are popular houseplants and ornamental plants for offices and shopping malls because they are among the easiest houseplants to grow. Numerous cultivars have been selected, including plants with variegated leaves. They prefer indirect light and partial shade. They do best in shadow-less light, such as a north window.

Aglaonema sp ( Lady Valentine) is hardy, drought-tolerant, low maintenance, air purifier, and good luck bringer houseplant, it does not require to be fed or watered frequently and does exceedingly well at indoors environment. These are outstanding shade plants, one of the most cultivated in ornamental plants horticulture.

title: Monstera Adansonii, Swiss Cheese Plant

Monstera adansonii, also known as the Swiss cheese plant, is both retro and trendy! A very easy to grow houseplant, it is prized for its deep glossy green foliage which as it grows is particularly impressive with large heart shaped leaves that have distinctive deeply cut leaves. The Swiss cheese plant is fairly easy to care for and maintain, but will need extra space to grow, it will add a beautiful tropical touch where ever you choose to locate it. Native of tropical rain forests of southern Mexico. Gentle sunlight is fine but direct sun might be harmful.

The Swiss Cheese plant, gets its name from its large, heart-shaped leaves, which become covered with holes that resemble swiss cheese as it gets older. Part of the Araceae family that's native to South and Central America, this Monstera is easy to grow and loves to climb and grow upwards.

Monstera obliqua is a species of the genus Monstera native to Central and South America. The most well known form of obliqua is the one from Peru, often described as being "more holes than leaf" but there are forms in the obliqua complex with little to no fenestration.

title: Calathea Orbifolia
body_html:
Calathea Orbifolia is a striking plant with large, oval-shaped light green leaves featuring deep purple undersides. Its vibrant foliage adds a touch of the exotic to any interior space. A great choice for low light areas, Calathea Orbifolia is easy to care for and requires minimal maintenance.

Widely loved for their bold, brightly patterned foliage, calathea are found most often on the forest floor in tropical locales. This means they're able to tolerate partially shady areas in your home and are pretty forgiving. Most calathea plants' leaves will fold up during the dark hours, which reveals the colorful undersides, making them a gorgeous addition to your indoor garden no matter the hour. The Orbifolia features a streaky foliage with contrasting dark and light green coloring. If your calathea leaves begin to brown, that typically means it's being underwatered or needs a more humid environment.

Calathea orbifolia is a species of a tropical plant that is commonly grown indoors. The reason why calatheas are common houseplants is due to their enormous, showy, decorative leaves.  These plants have large, silvery-green leaves with pronounced dark-colored veins.

The schefflera arboricola houseplant is a popular plant and comes in many varieties. The most well known are the umbrella tree and the dwarf umbrella tree. One of the reasons the plant is popular is because schefflera plant care is so easy, but, while schefflera care is easy, the plant does need to be cared for. Keep reading to learn more about growing schefflera and keeping it healthy and lush.

title: Ravenala Madagascariensis, Traveller’s Palm
body_html:
Max Height: 10-16m, Spread: 3-6m

Origin: Madagascar, Family: Strelitziaceae

Common Name: Travelers Palm, Flower Color: White

Salinity Tolerance: Low, Sun Tolerance: High

Wind Tolerance: Low, Water Requirement: Medium

PH level: Basic, Pest Tolerance: High

Disease Tolerance: Medium, Growth Rate: Medium

Travellers palms are not palms but related to the banana. They hold a large reserve of water in the leaf bases from which travellers could drink, but it would be a mighty desperate soul to partake of insect and debris laden cocktail contained in this travellers “Oasis”. The distinctive flat fan, formed by leafs and leaf bases makes the travelers palm a popular and unique ornamental. 

Ravenala madagascariensisor Traveller’s palm is Large, erect tree with an unbranched, palm-like trunk topped by a fan-shaped, crown of 2-ranked, paddle-shaped, leathery, lustrous, rich green leaves. The oblong leaf-blades, 2-4m long, are borne on thick, grooved stalks, of about the same length, closely overlapping at the bases. On mature plants, tiny, narrow white flowers, each with 6 tepals, emerge from pointed, boat-shaped, greenish white spathes, a few at a time, in summer; they are followed by fruit capsules that contain seeds with bright blue arils.

Cocos nucifera or coconut palm نخلة جوز الهند is large palm with a swollen, tapered base, an often-leaning grey trunk, and pinnate, bright green leaves, 4-6m long, with many linear leaflets. Small, bowl-shaped, fragrant, cream to yellow flowers are borne at intervals throughout the year, followed by ovoid fruit, each with a green to ochre-yellow or orange-red exterior covering a fibrous brown husk. Height 20-30cm, Spread 12m. Native of Coastal tropical region.

title: Lady Palm, Rhapis Excelsa,  Miniature Fan Palm
body_html:
Max Height: 1.5-5m Spread: 1-2m

Origin: S. China Family: Arecaceae/ Palmae

Sun Tolerance: Low Wind Tolerance: Low

Pest Tolerance: High Disease Tolerance: High

A delightful fan palm, with large, thick leaves, that are wider than many other palms and blunt tipped. Rhapis excelsa bears rhizome offshoots, leading to clusters of upright stems, perfect for a flourish of lush interior greenery. Thick fibres envelop new stems, these fall away in time to reveal bamboo-like trunks, and give the palm its other common name: Bamboo Palm. Rhapis excelsa is a versatile slow growing palm that adapts extremely well to being grown indoors in a container. It is not fussy about light or humidity, being one of the more shade tolerant palms.

Common name of Rhaphis excelsa is lady palm سيدة النخيل or miniature fan palm. Small, clump-forming palm with slender, erect, bamboo- or reed-like stems. The long-stalked, deeply lobed, lustrous, dark green leaves, 20-30cm long, each have 3-10 broadly to narrowly lance-shaped, puckered lobes. Tiny, bowl-shaped cream flowers are borne in panicles, to 12cm long, among the leaves, in summer.

Zamia furfuracea is also known as Cardboard palm.  Is a small cycad with a partly underground, simple or rarely branched, cylindrical trunk. Bears terminal whorls of semi-erect to spreading, pinnate leaves, to 1m long, each with up to 24 oblong or inversely lance-shaped to obovate, stiff, pale green leaflets, later olive-green, with red-brown hairs. Produces felted, red-brown female flower cones, 10-13cm long, usually in summer.

Also known as Sky Duster, Cotton Palm and Petticoat Palm, Washingtonia robusta epitomises Californian boulevards. The Mexican Fan Palm has a tall, slender reddish trunk that swells towards the base topped by a crown of large, bright green, fan-shaped leaves, with cotton-like threads hanging from each leaf. With its strong architectural features and tropical good looks, this palm is a must for all interior landscapers.

Washingtonia robusta is known as Mexican Fan Palm المكسيكية فان بالم. Is commonly seen at 40 to 50 feet but capable of soaring to 80 feet in height, Washington Palm is quickly recognized as the much-used, straight, singletrunked street palm of years past. The lower leaves persist on the tree after they die, forming a dense, brown, shaggy covering below the living, bright green, broad, fan-shaped leaves, giving it the common name of petticoat palm.

Livistona Chinensis or the Chinese fan palm or fountain palm is a species of the subtropical palm tree of east Asia. It is native to southern Japan, Taiwan, the Ryukyu Islands, southeastern China, and Hainan.

Livistona chinensis, Chinese Fan Palm or Fountain Palm is medium-sized palm with an erect, robust trunk swollen at the base, the upper part covered with fibrous leaf bases, at least at first. Glossy, rich green leaves, to 2m long, with shorter, spiny leaf-stalks, are divided for up to two-thirds of their leangth into many linear, pendent segments. Cream flowers are borne in panicles to 1m or more long, usually in summer, followed by ovoid to spherical, glossy, blue-green to grey-pink fruit, 2-2.5cm across.

The Date Palm, Phoenix Dactylifera, is a tree native to the Middle East, North Africa, and Pakistan. Its fruits are great sources of vitamins and minerals, especially vitamin C, potassium, and magnesium. Enjoy its great taste and health benefits in a variety of dishes.

Phoenix dactylifera or Date palm النخلة is tall, sometimes suckering palm producing a columnar trunk usually clad with old leaf bases, at least towards the top. Leaves, 4-6m long, are composed of many linear, greyish green leaflets, the lowest ones reduced to spines, arranged in various planes giving a 3-dimensional effect. Bowl-shaped cream flowers appear in long-stalked panicles, 1.5-2m long, in spring or summer. Ellipsoid to cylindrical, edible, sweet, fleshy, yellow to reddish brown fruit, 2.5-7cm long, are very variable both in texture and flavor.

body_html:
Spread: 30-40m Origin: Florida

Flower Colour: Purple Drought Tolerance: Medium

Ipomoea Pes-Caprae, commonly known as Railroad Vine or Railway Creeper, is a fast-growing vine that is ideal for softening hard edges, such as walls and fences. Once established, it grows quickly, reaching up to 20 ft of length, making it a great choice for enhancing privacy and adding texture to your outdoor living space.

It can cover 100 ft (30.5 m) as it races along the beach, but it never gets more than a few inches high. This is an evergreen perennial with a large, thick root that can be 10 ft (3.1 m) long and 2 in (5.1 cm) in diameter. The stem is flexible, 0.5 in (1.3 cm) in diameter, branches freely and roots at the nodes. The fleshy leathery leaves are about 4 in (10.2 cm) long and carried on petioles 6 in (15.2 m) long. The leaves are notched at the apex, creating two equal lobes which must have looked like the imprint of a goat’s foot to Professor Linnaeus who named the plant. The flowers are very showy, pink to lavender purple funnels about 2 in (5.1 m) long. Each flower opens only once, in the morning, but they keep coming almost all year long, peaking from May through November.

Allamanda cathartica or Golden trumpet is a tender woody vine much beloved by its bounty of huge yellow trumpet shaped flowers shown off against the attractive evergreen leathery dark green foliage. The very showy flowers have white and gold throats arranged in flower clusters. It will bloom throughout the year with stems twining around any support given like trellis, fences etc. Allamanda can be made a great houseplant if given bright light and reasonable care.

Allamanda is perennial in tropical climates and may be treated as an annual or brought inside during cold weather and replanted after danger of frost. The plant has milky sap and is considered poisonous; all parts are highly cathartic (hence the botanical name). Texture is coarse and leaves are bright to light green; the plant is often pruned and used as a shrub. Some cultivars have been bred for fragrance; a particularly popular one has furry brown buds and darker green leaves than the species.

title: Dracaena Draco, Drago, Dragon Tree
body_html:
What a statement piece for your indoor or garden! The Dragon Tree is a stunner from every angle. The dragon tree, also called dragon's blood plant or by its Latin name, Dracaena draco, is an evergreen succulent tree native to subtropical zones on and near the northwest coast of Africa. Dracaena draco is one of the world’s most unique and feature trees. Succulent branches and strap-like leaves, thick smooth trunk and blue-green foliage, even when young, Dracaena draco gives off an aura few plants can match. Its hardiness and will to survive make it the perfect plant for our drought stricken lands and worthy of the title ‘the ultimate in architectural planting’.

Dracaena draco is an evergreen tree with a single, smooth grey trunk which eventually becomes multi-stemmed when the plant is much older. Attractive blue-green leaves may grow up to 60cm (23 inch) long and 5cm (2 inch) wide. The leaves are somewhat severe, stiffly pointed that end in something resembling a spike. The leaves are solidly green, as the old leaves die the stem gradually unveils with a scaly pattern. The Dracaena draco will grow to 0.9-1.2m (3-4 feet) indoors.

title: String of Hearts, Ceropegia Woodii, Variegated
body_html:
30 – 40cm spread.

Adorn your favorite indoor or outdoor space with the ornate, Chain of Hearts. The String of Hearts (Ceropegia woodii) “Variegated” is South African native vine features gorgeous, small, variegated, purplish silver leaves in the shape of hearts. Once established, it will also produce flowers throughout the year. It is a low maintenance plant that is easy to propagate, drought tolerant and it can withstand occasional lower temperatures. Extremely versatile, you can plant it in pots, hanging baskets as well as in the ground.

The delicate heart-shaped foliage and slender vines can reach up to 12′ long in its natural environment, and has earned this plant many nicknames, including Rosary Vine and Sweetheart Vine.

Place your String of Hearts where it can receive plenty of bright indirect light. Small doses of direct sun are good, however too much direct sun can scorch the leaves. This plant is not suitable for lower light environments. A few feet removed from a southern or western-facing window is ideal, or directly in a northern or eastern-facing window will also suffice.

title: Ajuga Reptans, Bugleherb (small)
body_html:
Ajuga reptans is carpet bugleweed is a low growing evergreen perennial 6-10 in (15.2-25.4 cm) tall which forms a dense matlike groundcover as it spreads along underground stolons. As is typical of herbaceous plants in the mint family, bugleweed has square stems and opposite or whorled leaves. The basal leaves are dark green and oblong or spoon shaped, 3-5 in (7.6-12.7 cm) long and 1-2 in (2.5-5.1 cm) wide; stem leaves are a little smaller. The flowers (usually blue or purplish) are about 1/2 in (1.3 cm) long and borne in whorls on erect spikes 6-10 in (15.2-25.4 cm) tall. They are typical mint flowers: tubular with two unequal lips. Many cultivars have been selected for foliage or flower color. ‘Alba’ has white flowers. ‘Rubra’ has rosy red flowers. ‘Pink Elf’ has pink flowers and gets only about 2 in (5.1 cm) tall. ‘Jungle Bronze’ has bronze leaves and flower spikes to 10 in (25.4 cm) tall. ‘Jungle Beauty’ has unusually colorful foliage, consisting of purple leaves with red margins. ‘Purple Brocade’ has leaves variegated with purple. ‘Multicolor’ or ‘Rainbow’ has leaves variegated with cream and pink. ‘Variegata’ has gray green leaves variegated with cream.

Century plant is the common name usually associated with, Agave americana. title: Avicennia Marina, Mangroves
body_html:
Avicennia marina, commonly known as grey mangrove or white mangrove, is a species of mangrove tree classified in the plant family Acanthaceae (formerly in the Verbenaceae or Avicenniaceae). As with other mangroves, it occurs in the intertidal zones of estuarine areas. It is distributed along the east coast of Africa, throughout south and south-east Asia, and into Australia. In Australia, it extends much farther south than any other mangrove, occurring in every mainland State. It also occurs in New Zealand between 34 and 38 degrees South.

Beaucarnea recurvata is also known as Ponytail Palm, Bottle Palm, Nolina, Elephant-foot Tree. The ponytail is a weird palmlike succulent with a greatly expanded base and a single trunk with a rosette of long, straplike leaves that arch and droop. With age, the trunk eventually develops a few branches. Ponytail can get up to 30 ft (9.1 m) tall and the base up to 12 ft (3.7 m) across, but houseplants generally remain less than 6-8 ft (1.8-2.4 m) tall. The leaves are thin and flat, up to 6 ft (1.8 m) long and only 1 in (2.5 cm) wide. They are clustered in dense tufts at the ends of the branches and arch upward, then droop downward.

Oddly enough, a ponytail palm tree is neither a palm nor a tree. In fact, it is a member of the Agave family and is actually a succulent. In the past, it has been classified as either Nolina recurvata or Beaucarnea recurvata, but the latter is now the correct classification of this plant.

Saccharum Officinarum Or Sugarcane, a perennial plant, grows in clumps consisting of a number of strong unbranched stems. A network of rhizomes forms under the soil which sends up secondary shoots near the parent plant. The stems vary in colour, being green, pinkish, or purple and can reach 5 m (16 ft) in height. They are jointed, nodes being present at the bases of the alternate leaves. The internodes contain a fibrous white pith immersed in sugary sap. The elongated, linear, green leaves have thick midribs and saw-toothed edges and grow to a length of about 30 to 60 cm (12 to 24 in) and width of 5 cm (2.0 in). The terminal inflorescence is a panicle up to 60 cm (24 in) long, a pinkish plume that is broadest at the base and tapering towards the top.

The trunk remains somewhat succulent and soft wooded, and never develops true bark. It is ringed with prominent scars from previous leaf stems and contains an acrid milky latex sap. The smooth-skinned fruits are green, yellow, orange or rose colored, and can weigh as much as 20 pounds (9.1 kg), but typically are about a pound (0.5 kg). title: Alocasia Gageana, Elephant Ear, Alocasia California
body_html:
Alocasia California, more commonly known as the Upright Elephant Ear or Night Scented Elephant Ear, is known for its stand out paddle shaped leaves and its fragrant blooms whose perfume is extra intense and beautiful at night. Alocasia California’is a tuberous plant that is native to East and South East Asia and has long been used as a remedy for the common cold in Northern Vietnam.

This stunning plant can turn any garden into a tropical oasis, with its large glossy leaves and hardy stems adding a burst of bright green to any plant bed or pot. As the bold, tropical leaves stand upright, they can shed excess water easily, whilst also allowing companion plants to grow underneath. In their preferred conditions of a tropical or subtropical climate, it can grow to its full height of over 15 ft, but in more temperate climates it will be significantly smaller, reaching up to 5 ft in just one summer. These heat loving plants will happily grow in full sunlight or partial shade and will require regular watering during their growth season.

Each plant We offer is Hybridized and grown from tissue cultures to be a disease free exact replica of the mother plant. Alocasia Gagaena California is considered a dwarf elephant ear and can reach up to 4′ in height. This variety can fill an area quickly and is a top choice as a landscape plant. Quite unique and very beautiful.

title: Blue Star Fern, Phlebodium Blue Star
body_html:
The Phlebodium Blue Star, or Blue Star Fern, is ideal for adding a dramatic touch to any landscape. Its striking, vibrant blue-green foliage stands out in any setting, and requires minimal maintenance to keep its spectacular color. Its strong root system and need for minimal sunlight make it a perfect addition to low-light indoor spaces.

A fascinating and funky fern, less delicate in appearance than many of its contemporaries. The sturdy, elongated, blue-green fronds curl into non-conforming straps, spilling from the plant in a delightfully higgledy-piggledy manner. A great, undemanding houseplant, providing a perfect background for other foliage plants or to soften a dark corner.

Blue Star Fern, with its soft blue-green leaves, is an epiphyte. For those not fully up on their greek etymology, an epiphyte is a plant that grows on another plant. In tropical forests in the Americas, phlebodium aureum will nestle in the branches of huge trees. It can grow to enormous sizes, sometimes with leaves as long as 130cm.

title: Aralia Fabian, Polyscias Fabian
body_html:
Polyscias are versatile, small, indoor, branching trees. They grow in an upright and compact manner, making them suitable even in smaller spaces. Their thick, woody trunks is their main appeal. The large, rounded leaves grow along the full length of the branches, creating a mass of green tranquillity for your home. They are often called Dinner Plate Aralia due to their round, flat leaf shape. Polyscias translates from the Greek as "many" and "shade", a reference to their abundant foliage. Polyscias scutellaria Fabian has large, scalloped, dark green, glossy leaves that curve outwards slightly. They are deeply veined and tinged purple underneath.

The Polyscias, also known as Aralia, occurs naturally on islands in the Pacific Ocean. A Polyscias is a characteristic tree that likes to stand in a shady location and needs little water. Polyscias literally means "much shade" in Greek. This houseplant has the property that leaves grow over the entire branch. Leaves of a Polyscias are green, white or yellow and have a round or heart-shaped appearance. This houseplant is highly recommended for the dark spot in your room or office.

body_html:

Croton Iceton is a stunningly beautiful foliage plant with fantastic leaf colour and variegation. The mid-green leaves are glossy with pointed tips and each have a vivid splash of red, pink, yellow or orange. Highly ornamental, it could almost be considered a work of art. Codiaeum Iceton is a definite eye-catcher and looks stunning in taller planters.

Crotons grow best in well-drained soil and in full sun to partial shade; in hot sunny climates they look best if shaded from the hottest sun of the day. Too much sun will bleach the color out of the leaves and too little will cause the leaves to be more green. Provide plenty of room for growth, crotons can be pruned by hand but are ugly sheared. Crotons are frequently grown as houseplants in colder climates and in the landscape in frost-free regions. Crotons make excellent accent plants, hedges and tub specimens.

title: Calathea Mosaica, Network
body_html:
The Calathea Musaica Network is a real eye-catcher. Once you have a close look at the graphic, very detailed leaf pattern, it’s almost hard to believe it’s all mother nature’s work. This unique leaf pattern is far from the Calathea Musaica Network’s only special feature. For one, the Calathea has strong air-purifying properties. This means that the plant not only produces extra oxygen, but also filters harmful substances from the air. Another special Calathea Rufibarba Elgergrass feature is the fact that its leaves move around. A characteristic to which the plant owes its nickname “living plant”. Its leaves spread open in the morning to catch the light, and in the evening they close by going upwards. This opening and closing looks a bit like praying hands, as a result of which the Calathea is also called “prayer plant”. The movements the plant makes are so fast that you can actually hear the leaves rustle a bit!

Calathea Network has beautifully decorated leaves and is an unusually graceful plant for any home. The striking leaves of the ‘Network’ seem almost as if etched onto the surface; thin strokes for dark green create a mosaic affect across the leaf lamina. A striking addition to any collection and one of the easier Calatheas to maintain. Calathea plant likes bright indirect light. Too much direct sunlight will burn the leaves.

title: Ficus Amstel Queen
body_html:

The Ficus Amstel Queen is an attractive, medium-sized tree, perfect for adding natural texture to any garden or yard. Its dense foliage creates a luxurious canopy, providing an inviting spot to relax in the shade. It grows quickly, reaching heights of up to 10 feet in 1-3 years. Enjoy the beauty and luxury of a Ficus Amstel Queen in your backyard.

Ficus Queen is an evergreen tree. The flowers bloom in spring and are followed by small fruit that may be green or yellow maturing to red. The simple dark green leaves of the beautiful Amstel Queen are glossy and attractive. Ficus Amstel Queen (Long Leaf Fig) has cream, pink and green leaves.  Ficus Amstel Queen has long, banana-shaped leaves. The large, leathery, fast-growing foliage has a lush tropical appeal. This plant has similar growth habits to Ficus Alli but has much wider, thicker, and somewhat larger leaves. During active growth periods, growth tips are a very pronounced pink to red that contrasts beautifully against the broad, shiny leaves.

These easy-going house plants are very simple to care for as long as you don't overwater them and they get enough light. Only water once the compost has fully dried out. They benefit from the leaves getting an occasional wash with a damp sponge and increased humidity from misting.
